channel.title: The Grant Desk - Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship 2027 (tuition plus USD 50,000 stipend) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
Jane Street
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: Full tuition and fees for the award year plus a USD 50,000 stipend (or local-currency equivalent; taxable). Finalists receive USD 5,000. No application fee.

Jane Street's Graduate Research Fellowship supports exceptional doctoral students in electrical engineering and computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics; research does not need to relate to trading.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme 2027/28 (HKD 344,400 a year for up to three years; 400 fellowships, practice-led art PhDs included) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Research Grants Council (RGC) of Hong Kong, with eight Hong Kong universities
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 Hong Kong time
Award: Annual stipend of HKD 344,400 (about USD 44,150) plus a conference and research travel allowance of HKD 14,400 a year, for up to three years (2026/27 rates as published by the RGC). Some universities add top-ups: HKBU lists a HKD 40,000-a-year Elite Scholar Award for three years, a further HKD 20,000 travel top-up, four years of tuition waiver and two years of guaranteed accommodation. 400 fellowships for 2027/28.

The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme, run by the Research Grants Council, funds around 400 new full-time PhD students a year at eight Hong Kong universities, in any discipline, including AI, computing and data science programmes and practice-led art research (Hong Kong Baptist University's Academy...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Mophradat New Agents 2027: collective curatorial program (USD 6,000 stipend, Arab world) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
Mophradat
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026
Award: USD 6,000 stipend per participant, to use at their discretion, paid 2,500 / 2,500 / 1,000. Mophradat also covers retreat travel and a budget for the public event. Number of participants not stated (a small group). No application fee stated.

New Agents brings a small group of art practitioners (artists, curators and researchers) together for ten months to co-develop and realise a public event, such as a conference, festival or exhibition, that foregrounds the collective curatorial experience rather than the participants' individual...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Jumping Frames 2027: Hong Kong International Movement-Image Festival, Open Call (Copy Right Copy Left) (closes 16 Dec)
item.description:
City Contemporary Dance Company (CCDC)
Deadline: 16 Dec 2026
Award: Jumping Frames International Award HKD 15,000 (figure from secondary listings of the 2027 call; confirm on the official site). Entry fees vary by deadline tier.

Open call for dance and movement-image films up to 20 minutes for the 2027 Jumping Frames festival. The 2027 theme, Copy Right Copy Left, explicitly invites AI and digital tools and asks about authorship in the AI era.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: HKADC Cultural Exchange Project Grant (up to HKD 500,000 for Hong Kong artists working abroad) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
Hong Kong Arts Development Council (HKADC)
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026, 18:00 Hong Kong time
Award: General Version: up to HKD 500,000 for individual artists and arts organisations, covering all project expenditure except listed exclusions; up to HKD 800,000 for experienced organisations with large-scale, outstanding exchange projects. Trial Version: up to HKD 150,000 for transportation, freight, insurance and documentation only. No application fee stated.

The Hong Kong Arts Development Council's Cultural Exchange Project Grant supports Hong Kong artists and arts organisations taking work abroad: overseas exhibitions, performances, festival participation, residencies, touring and similar exchange activity, across music, dance, xiqu, drama, visual...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: HKADC Emerging Artists Development Grant (up to HKD 90,000, Hong Kong arts graduates) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
Hong Kong Arts Development Council (HKADC)
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026, 18:00 Hong Kong time
Award: Grant ceiling HKD 90,000 per project (HKADC may exceed the ceiling for projects of great potential, subject to resources). No application fee stated.

The Hong Kong Arts Development Council's Emerging Artists Development Grant funds a first arts project by recent graduates: performances, exhibitions, publications, creation of artwork, translation and other project types allowed under its general Project Grant.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: 51st Hong Kong International Film Festival 2027: Call for Entries (features, documentaries, Short Film Competition) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
Hong Kong International Film Festival Society (HKIFF)
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026
Award: EXCEPTION: NOT FUNDED (festival call). Selection for one of Asia's oldest film festivals and its competitions; prize amounts not stated in the call. Entry fees from 4 November to 31 December 2026: Short Film Competition (under 20 minutes) USD 50 / HKD 390; all other categories USD 80 / HKD 624. Fee waiver for documentaries by directors holding a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card. Fees non-refundable.

The Hong Kong International Film Festival, one of Asia's oldest film festivals, is taking submissions for its 51st edition (16-29 March 2027).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: YAO Residency #02 (Taiwan): Research Residency 2027 and Exhibition 2028
item.description: YAO Residency Program (Yao Zuo Zhu Cun Ji Hua) · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · Research Residency 2027: travel support (international applicants reimbursed up to NTD 20,000 for one round-trip to Taiwan against receipts), production budget up to NTD 20,000, living stipend of NTD 10,000, accommodation, Open Studio venue, local connections, and documentation, text editing, translation and promotional support. Exhibition Phase 2028: travel support up to NTD 20,000 again, a further NTD 10,000 living stipend, accommodation, exhibition venue at YAO, installation and de-installation assistance, and exhibition documentation. Application fee: NTD 300 for Taiwan-based applicants (bank transfer) or USD 10 for international applicants (PayPal), non-refundable.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council Individual Fellowship 2027 (up to USD 35,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 35,000 for self-directed exploration and cultural exchange of 1 to 6 months. Single or joint applications (up to 3 participants). No application fee.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council New York Fellowship 2027 (USD 38,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · USD 38,000 for the six-month fellowship, covering the immersive cultural exchange in New York City. No application fee.

item.title: Busan Metropolitan City: Open Call for Land / Ecological Art on Eulsukdo
item.description: Busan Metropolitan City, Urban Parks Division · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · One proposal selected. Artwork support KRW 380,000,000 (approx. EUR 235,000) plus artist fee KRW 20,000,000 (approx. EUR 12,500). No entry fee indicated.

item.title: 2027 ACC NEXT Emerging Asian Artists International Open Call (Gwangju)
item.description: National Asian Culture Center (ACC) · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Artist fee of KRW 3,000,000 per work, an installation and materials budget of up to KRW 2,000,000 per work, one round-trip international airfare (or domestic transportation), and tentative accommodation at Asia Plex Studio. One artist or team is additionally selected for the 2027 ACC CREATORS Residency through an artist pitch review. For teams, fees, travel and accommodation go to the team leader only.
